params.name: gameId
params.description: Filter by game id.

params.name: classId
params.description: Filter by section id (discoverable via Categories)

params.name: categoryId
params.description: Filter by category id

params.name: categoryIds
params.description:
Filter by a list of category ids - this will override categoryId
categoryIds=[1,2,3...]
            
The maximum allowed category ids per query is 10

params.name: gameVersion
params.description: Filter by game version string

params.name: gameVersions
params.description:
Filter by a list of game version strings - this will override
gameVersion
            
gameVersions=["1.19.1", "1.19.2", "1.20.1" ...]
            
The maximum allowed category ids per query is 4

params.name: searchFilter
params.description: Filter by free text search in the mod name and author

params.name: sortField
params.description: Filter by ModsSearchSortField enumeration

params.name: sortOrder
params.description: 'asc' if sort is in ascending order, 'desc' if sort is in descending order

params.name: modLoaderType
params.description: Filter only mods associated to a given modloader (Forge, Fabric ...). Must be coupled with gameVersion.

params.name: modLoaderTypes
params.description:
Filter by a list of mod loader types - this will override modLoaderType
modLoaderTypes=[Forge, Fabric, ...]
            
Max values = 5

params.name: gameVersionTypeId
params.description: Filter only mods that contain files tagged with versions of the given gameVersionTypeId

params.name: authorId
params.description: Filter only mods that the given authorId is a member of.

params.name: primaryAuthorId
params.description: Filter only mods that the given primaryAuthorId is the owner of.

params.name: PremiumType
params.description: Filter only mods that are Premium or not.

params.name: slug
params.description: Filter by slug (coupled with classId will result in a unique result).

params.name: clientCompatible
params.description:
When set to true, will filter out any mod that doesn't have a default
file that is compatible with the client. This is usually due to a bad
file structure of the file (which might cause unexpected behaviours on
the user's machine - such as overriding other mods installed).

params.name: modsSearchEnhancedFeatures
params.description: Bitwise number with values from ModsSearchEnhancedFeatures

params.name: index
params.description: A zero based index of the first item to include in the response,  the limit is: (index + pageSize <= 10,000).

params.name: pageSize
params.description: The number of items to include in the response,  the default/maximum value is 50.

items.docs: Get all mods that match the search criteria.
